cases.title: A pipe drawn by CD starting on a downpipe joins it: the flow line says DP1 -> Open end and only the far end is free
cases.plan_item: UX-DP-02 the drafter draws the DP connection pipe (the pipe joins the downpipe)
cases.expected: DP at 150000,-80000 places DP1 ('The source connects when a pipe is drawn to it.'); Esc stops it. CD from 150000,-80000 to 170000,-80000 with inverts 18.000 / 17.900 and Start Pipe draws one pipe; the command line says 'Inserted flow arrow. Flow: DP1 -> Open end' once and 'End is free: open end flagged, connect it later.' once; no line says 'Flow: Open end -> Open end'. One new downpipe and one new pipe exist.
cases.why_not_unit: The join is made by the live CD point landing on the real downpipe block in the drawing.
not_automated: A downpipe found from the architect's Xref (UX-DP-01) and the roof split (UX-DP-03) are not driven.
The downpipe's own record (which pipe it now feeds) is not read; the join is proved by CE's flow line, as R02 does for a pit.
